description: This file defines the PathBasedBreadcrumbBuilder class for building path-based breadcrumbs in Drupal, implementing breadcrumb construction logic based on URL paths, access checks, and route matching.

classes.name: PathBasedBreadcrumbBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds breadcrumbs based on URL paths, implementing the BreadcrumbBuilderInterface for Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies such as request context, access manager, router, path processor, config, title resolver, current user, current path, and path matcher.

methods.name: applies
methods.description: Determines if the breadcrumb builder applies to the current route; always returns TRUE.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the breadcrumb trail based on the current route and path, adding links for parent paths and the front page.

methods.name: getRequestForPath
methods.description: Matches a given path to a request object, considering exclusions and handling exceptions during request creation and path processing.
